description: Navigation + the two new screens. Update the bottom-nav shell to Home/Read/Learn/Profile and the router to make Read -> surah selection, add full-screen /reader/:id and /lesson/:id/complete routes (design-mapping.md §6). Create surah_selection_screen.dart (Read tab) and lesson_completion_screen.dart (celebration), both driven only by existing providers + route extra. Depends on FEAT-001 (theme + shared widgets). After it, all four tabs and the two new routes build and navigate.
steps: Read design-mapping.md §2 (screens 03 and 07), §5 (data contracts), §6 (router/shell) and context.json. Read mobile/lib/app/home_shell.dart and router.dart before editing.

Restyle mobile/lib/app/home_shell.dart: NavigationBar with 4 destinations Home(Icons.explore)/Read(Icons.menu_book)/Learn(Icons.school)/Profile(Icons.person), translucent surface (95%) + top hairline border (outlineVariant), selected primary+semibold. Keep StatefulNavigationShell + goBranch(_onTap) logic.

Create mobile/lib/features/quran_reader/presentation/surah_selection_screen.dart (SurahSelectionScreen, ConsumerWidget): HudaayahTopBar(tab 'Read'), SearchField (local filter), FilterChipBar (All/Makki/Madani/Bookmarked/Juz), a ResumeBanner (feature-local widget) from the most-recent in-progress lesson, 'Sacred Chapters' header, a list of SurahListTile (feature-local widget under presentation/widgets/), and a 'Daily Wisdom' InfoCard footer. Drive the list from progressSummaryProvider.lessons joined with a static _surahCatalog map (surah number, English name, meaning, ayah count, Makki/Madani, Arabic title ONLY — NO ayah/verse text). Completed -> 100% check badge; otherwise progress bar (0 if unknown, no fabricated percentages). Each tile taps to context.go('/reader/<lessonId>').
Create mobile/lib/features/quran_reader/presentation/widgets/surah_list_tile.dart (SurahListTile) and resume_banner.dart (ResumeBanner) as presentational widgets per §2 screen 03.

Create mobile/lib/features/progress/presentation/lesson_completion_screen.dart (LessonCompletionScreen, ConsumerWidget) taking the session summary map {correct,total,xp_earned}: header (close -> /home), decorative check medallion, 'Alhamdulillah!' (displaySmall), encouraging subtitle, a StreakSummaryCard (feature-local: streak + '+1 today' + '+XP' chips + 7-day check row) from summary + progressSummaryProvider, a vocab StatCard (only counts present in summary), and the 'Ayah of Encouragement' card ONLY if content supplies an ayah (otherwise omit Arabic and show our-own encouraging sentence). Two CTAs: 'Continue to Dashboard' (PrimaryPillButton/primaryContainer) -> /home and 'Review Lesson Notes' (SecondaryButton) -> /reader/<id>. Footer AppConfig.qfAttribution. No new provider/API.

Edit mobile/lib/app/router.dart: in the shell's Read branch replace GoRoute('/reader' -> ReaderScreen(lessonId:1)) with GoRoute('/surah' -> SurahSelectionScreen()) and set the branch initialLocation to '/surah'. Add top-level GoRoute('/reader/:id') building ReaderScreen(lessonId: parsed id) via a loader-style widget (reuse existing lessonProvider pattern if a loader is needed). Add top-level GoRoute('/lesson/:id/complete') building LessonCompletionScreen with summary read from state.extra. Keep all other routes, redirect, and _AuthRefresh unchanged.
Update existing navigation calls that targeted '/reader': home _HabitCard.onContinue and any others to context.go('/reader/1').
Run the verification gate and record results (including which build gate ran) in findings.
acceptance_criteria: Bottom nav shows Home/Read/Learn/Profile in that order with the §3.1 icons; selected item is primary + semibold; bar is translucent with a top hairline.
Read tab opens SurahSelectionScreen; tapping a surah navigates to /reader/<id>.
surah_selection_screen.dart contains NO Quran ayah/verse text (only catalog metadata); progress shown is derived from LessonProgress, not fabricated.
/lesson/:id/complete renders LessonCompletionScreen from a summary map passed via route extra; CTAs navigate to /home and /reader/<id>.
flutter analyze reports zero new errors and the app builds.
verification: cd mobile && flutter build apk --debug  (fallback: flutter build web / analyze-only — record which ran)
findings:
SHELL (lib/app/home_shell.dart): NavigationBar now has 4 destinations in order Home(Icons.explore / explore_outlined) / Read(Icons.menu_book) / Learn(Icons.school) / Profile(Icons.person). Bar is translucent surface@0.95 with a top hairline (DecoratedBox Border top = AppTheme.outlineVariant). StatefulNavigationShell + goBranch(_onTap) logic UNCHANGED. Selected primary+semibold comes from the FEAT-001 navigationBarTheme (not overridden here).

ROUTER (lib/app/router.dart): Read branch route is now GoRoute('/surah', name:'surah' -> SurahSelectionScreen()), branch initialLocation '/surah'. The old in-shell '/reader' route and its name 'reader' were REMOVED. Added TWO top-level (outside shell) routes: GoRoute('/reader/:id', name:'reader' -> ReaderScreen(lessonId: parsed id, default 1)) and GoRoute('/lesson/:id/complete', name:'lessonComplete' -> LessonCompletionScreen(lessonId: parsed id, summary: state.extra as Map<String,dynamic>?)). The route NAME 'reader' moved from the branch to the top-level /reader/:id route (only one route may own a name) — later FEATs navigating to the reader should use context.go('/reader/<id>') or goNamed('reader', pathParameters:{'id':...}). /onboarding, /auth, /lesson/:id/practice (name 'practice'), /home, /review, /profile, redirect, and _AuthRefresh are UNCHANGED.

HOME NAV FIX (lib/features/progress/presentation/home_screen.dart): _HabitCard.onContinue changed from context.go('/reader') to context.go('/reader/1') because the bare /reader route no longer exists. No other '/reader' string references exist in mobile/lib.

NEW SCREEN — Read tab (lib/features/quran_reader/presentation/surah_selection_screen.dart, SurahSelectionScreen = ConsumerStatefulWidget for local search/filter state): HudaayahTopBar(tab:'Read', streakDays from progressSummaryProvider), SearchField (local _query filter on name/meaning), FilterChipBar(['All','Makki','Madani','Bookmarked','Juz']) — only Makki/Madani actually filter (Bookmarked/Juz have no local data so show all; honest), ResumeBanner (shown only when a lesson is in-progress i.e. state != 'completed' && != 'not_started'; hidden otherwise), 'Sacred Chapters' header, SurahListTile list, 'Daily Wisdom' InfoCard footer. DRIVEN BY progressSummaryProvider.lessons joined with a static _surahCatalog (lessonId/number/name/meaning/ayahCount/revelationPlace/arabicTitle ONLY — NO ayah/verse text). Catalog currently has lesson 1 Al-Fatihah and lesson 2 Al-Baqarah (pilot pre-live scope); EXTEND _surahCatalog when more lessons ship. Completed -> check badge; else LinearProgressIndicator with value 0/1 only (no fabricated %). Each tile + resume banner -> context.go('/reader/<lessonId>'). Feature-local widgets: presentation/widgets/surah_list_tile.dart (SurahListTile) and resume_banner.dart (ResumeBanner).

NEW SCREEN — completion (lib/features/progress/presentation/lesson_completion_screen.dart, LessonCompletionScreen = ConsumerWidget, props: int lessonId + Map<String,dynamic>? summary): header close -> /home, _CheckMedallion (decorative), 'Alhamdulillah!' (displaySmall/primary), encouraging subtitle (our own copy), StreakSummaryCard(streakDays from progressSummaryProvider, xpEarned from summary['xp_earned']), a vocab StatCard rendered ONLY when BOTH summary['correct'] and summary['total'] are present ('<correct> / <total>'), two CTAs: PrimaryPillButton 'Continue to Dashboard' (trailingIcon:null) -> /home and SecondaryButton 'Review Lesson Notes' -> /reader/<lessonId>, footer AppConfig.qfAttribution. The 'Ayah of Encouragement' Arabic card from the Stitch mock is DELIBERATELY OMITTED: no backend content/ayah reaches this screen, so rendering Arabic would mean hardcoding verse text (forbidden by quran-content-rules). Instead a gentle plain-text UI sentence is shown. If a later FEAT wants that card, it must pass a real encouragement ayah from the lesson/content layer (summary carries only {correct,total,xp_earned}). summary keys parsed via num->int tolerant helper; any missing key is skipped, never fabricated. Feature-local widget: presentation/widgets/streak_summary_card.dart (StreakSummaryCard({required int streakDays, int? xpEarned}); '+XP' chip omitted when xpEarned null; 7-day row fills min(streak,7)).

REUSED FEAT-001 shared widgets as-is (no signature changes): HudaayahTopBar, SearchField, FilterChipBar, InfoCard, StatCard, PrimaryPillButton, SecondaryButton. FilterChipBar/SearchField/InfoCard signatures matched FEAT-001 findings exactly. NOTE for exercises FEAT: on session.isComplete, navigate context.go('/lesson/<id>/complete', extra: session.summary) where summary is the {correct,total,xp_earned} map — that is exactly what LessonCompletionScreen reads.
